findings.title: Recreate exit code silently changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE moves from 4 to 3 and FEATURE_DISABLED takes the value 4. Any pipeline or script that already branches on exit code 4 to mean 'recreate upgrade required' will now misread a 'recreate' result as a feature-disabled error, or the reverse. The renumbering is not called out in the PR description. If the command is still considered preview, that should be stated explicitly, or the new code should be introduced without reusing a value that existing consumers depend on.

findings.title: Feature-disabled test does not assert the exit code
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only checks the error message. The new behaviour's key contract, documented in update-compatibility.adoc as exit code 4, is never verified, so a regression in the exit code (for example the renumbering above) would go unnoticed for the metadata and check commands.

findings.title: setEnabledFeatures overwrites any features already configured on the test deployment
findings.body: createInitialDeployment calls setEnabledFeatures(List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES)) on the FeatureSpec, replacing whatever enabled features getTestKeycloakDeployment() configured. If the base deployment enables other features, the tests silently lose them. The code should append to the existing list instead of replacing it.
